title: DeepMind's Hassabis proposes FINRA-style independent body to vet frontier AI
summary: Demis Hassabis called for an industry-funded but independent standards body that would review frontier models up to 30 days before release.
reason: Lab leader governance proposal; words not action, so T1 signal.

title: New York becomes first US state to impose a data-center moratorium
summary: Governor Kathy Hochul's executive order paused certain state environmental permits for data centers of 50 MW or more while regulators develop standards.
reason: First statewide pause on AI infrastructure; concrete backlash policy.

title: Ex-Meta staff sue, alleging AI ranking system targeted workers on leave in layoffs
summary: 26 former Meta employees allege the company used AI-generated performance data to pick layoff targets without excluding people on parental or medical leave.
reason: Allegation of AI used to cut jobs unfairly; lawsuit only.
